import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Node {
        int row, col, dist;
        Node(int row, int col, int dist) {
            this.row = row;
            this.col = col;
            this.dist = dist;
        }
    }

    static final int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static Queue<Node> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static char[] s = new char[15];
    static int n, n1, m, lim, tot, p;
    static int[][] a = new int[11][11], b = new int[11][11], d0 = new int[11][11], f = new int[202][202], d = new int[202][202], w = new int[202], h = new int[202], g = new int[203];
    static boolean t, flag, ok[][] = new boolean[12][12], okb[][] = new boolean[12][12];

    static void search(int x, int z) {
        if (x == n + 1) {
            p = z;
            flag = true;
            return;
        }
        int temp = n + 2;
        for (int y = 0; y <= n + 1; y++) {
            if (d[x][y] < f[x][y]) {
                temp = Math.min(temp, h[y]);
                if (h[x] == h[y] + 1) {
                    w[++tot] = y;
                    search(y, Math.min(z, f[x][y] - d[x][y]));
                    if (!t || flag) return;
                    w[tot--] = 0;
                }
            }
            if (d[y][x] > 0) {
                temp = Math.min(temp, h[y]);
                if (h[x] == h[y] + 1) {
                    w[++tot] = -y;
                    search(y, Math.min(z, d[y][x]));
                    if (!t || flag) return;
                    w[tot--] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        if (temp + 1 != h[x]) {
            g[h[x]]--;
            if (g[h[x]] == 0) t = false;
            h[x] = temp + 1;
            g[h[x]]++;
        }
    }

    static boolean improvable() {
        flag = false;
        p = n1;
        tot = 0;
        w[0] = 0;
        search(0, n1);
        return flag;
    }

    static void improve() {
        for (int x = 1; x <= tot; x++) {
            if (w[x] > 0)
                d[Math.abs(w[x - 1])][w[x]] += p;
            else
                d[-w[x]][Math.abs(w[x - 1])] -= p;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int m_input = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int lim_input = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = m_input;
        lim = lim_input;

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            s = br.readLine().toCharArray();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if (s[j - 1] == 'Z') {
                    Node he = new Node(i, j, 0);
                    q.add(he);
                } else if (s[j - 1] != 'Y') {
                    ok[i][j] = true;
                    d0[i][j] = lim;
                    int k = s[j - 1] - '0';
                    if (k > 0) {
                        a[i][j] = ++n;
                        f[0][n] = k;
                        n1 += k;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            s = br.readLine().toCharArray();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if (s[j - 1] == 'Z' || s[j - 1] == 'Y') continue;
                int k = s[j - 1] - '0';
                if (k > 0) {
                    b[i][j] = ++n;
                    f[n][m * m + 1] = k;
                }
            }
        }

        if (n != m * m) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                    if (b[i][j] > 0) {
                        int k = b[i][j];
                        f[k][n + 1] = f[k][m * m + 1];
                        f[k][m * m + 1] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] == 0) continue;
                System.arraycopy(ok, 0, okb, 0, ok.length);
                for (int x = 0; x < okb.length; x++) {
                    System.arraycopy(ok[x], 0, okb[x], 0, ok[x].length);
                }
                ok[i][j] = false;
                Node he = new Node(i, j, 0);
                q.add(he);
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    Node he2 = q.poll();
                    int x = he2.row, y = he2.col;
                    if (b[x][y] > 0 && he2.dist <= d0[x][y]) {
                        f[a[i][j]][b[x][y]] = n1;
                    }
                    if (he2.dist + 1 > lim || he2.dist >= d0[x][y]) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                        int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                        if (nx >= 1 && nx <= m && ny >= 1 && ny <= m && ok[nx][ny]) {
                            q.add(new Node(nx, ny, he2.dist + 1));
                            ok[nx][ny] = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        g[0] = n + 2;
        t = true;
        while (t && h[0] <= n + 2) {
            while (improvable()) {
                improve();
            }
        }

        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            ans += d[i][n + 1];
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
